findings.message: Return InPlaceDeferred for transient kubelet resize errors. In UpdateModeInPlace, this change classifies ResizeStatusError as permanent infeasibility, violating the required next-loop deferral behavior.
findings.evidence: Lines 142–161 route ResizeStatusError to InPlaceInfeasible; the previous return was InPlaceDeferred. Lines 127–132 return InPlaceInfeasibleCached when a recorded infeasible attempt has no lower recommendation. Thus, if the caller records this result, a transient error can suppress subsequent eligibility checks even after the error clears. Caller-side recording is not supplied.

result.coverage: Inspected TASK.json, CHANGE.diff, and the entire staged production file. Verified that the changed decision affects UpdateModeInPlace; the InPlaceOrRecreate path is unchanged. Documentation and logging changes describe the same defect, not separate findings.
limitations: Caller-side cache population, resize-status extraction, and recommendation comparison implementations are unavailable; downstream retry suppression is conditional on caller behavior.
result.contribution: Established the changed return value and local cache guard from source, while limiting downstream impact to what the supplied code supports.
